_readme: Add documented building heights/floors here (e.g. from the Korean building register 건축물대장 via data.go.kr, or VWorld building data). Keys are OSM ids like 'way/474085534'. Each entry needs a 'source'. Values here take precedence over OSM tags and are labelled 'documented'. Leave empty if you have no documented values - never put guesses here. Entries may set "status": "estimated" for non-documented, source-described estimates (e.g. from photographs); these stay labelled estimated.

way/473963422.source: Published guidebook: 조명화, 『캠퍼스투어008 경희대학교』 (Google Books) - gate width 62 m, height 22.5 m (incl. sculpture), 39 sculpted figures, completed 2001
way/473963422.note: OSM footprint length is 59.2 m vs 62 m published (difference likely end statue bases/steps or footprint generalisation).

way/474085534.source: estimated from aerial/oblique photographs of the library (raised podium + ~4 storeys under a giant colonnade, ≈21 m); not a documented value

way/585696506.source: estimated from photographs (brick arcade ~14 m to cornice + inset metal upper storey; clock tower ~37 m); not a documented value

way/170482640.source: estimated from 3 reference photos (5 storeys counted on the south face: ~3.6 m ground floor + 4 x 3.3 m + 0.9 m parapet = 17.7 m above the parking-lot level, which the DTM puts ~3.3 m above the footprint's lowest ground); not a documented value

relation/8269760.source: Main roof estimated from the east elevation photographs at about 23.8 m above the parking deck (24.3 m above the footprint's lowest ground). Kyung Hee University's Institute of International Education documents seven storeys above ground and one basement.

way/455725718.source: Photo estimate for the main roof: five levels counted on the west facade and about 17.6 m above the car park, scaled from the 78.1 m OSM facade and adjusted to the lowest ground using FABDEM. The clock fins extend about 4.9 m above the roof.

way/585696507.source: Four levels counted across the stadium-facing classroom block. The highest entrance roof is estimated at 21.4 m above the footprint's lowest FABDEM ground, or about 16.3 m above the entrance forecourt.

way/474085540.source: Five levels counted on the north facade. The front roof slab is estimated at 22.5 m above the lowest FABDEM ground on the mapped footprint, about 19.2 m above the north entrance apron.

way/474085536.source: estimated from photographs (2-storey colonnaded base + ~8-storey main block; corner towers ~41 m); not a documented value
